conviction_note: Top line is pre-announced so the only live information is below it; the findings sum to -1.6 and I tilt to -1.8 because the stock has already been paid for the beat (close $2.15 on 2026-08-03, +4.65% to $2.25 on the 2026-08-04 pre-announcement, $2.565 today = +19.3%), leaving a print whose remaining content is a C$57.9m Remexian put-option remeasurement, working capital, and a next-morning call.

findings.finding: High Tide carries a C$57.9m derivative liability for the put option over the 49% of Remexian it does not own, priced at 3.64065x Remexian's trailing annual EBITDA and valued by Monte Carlo with 82% annualised EBITDA volatility and a 15% IRR — so the liability ratchets up mechanically with exactly the record German quarter (10+ tonnes, +33% sequential) the company pre-announced, and the remeasurement lands below the three metrics the pre-announcement quantified.
findings.why_not_priced: The Aug 4 pre-announcement quantified revenue, gross profit and adjusted EBITDA — the three measures that all exclude this item — and every wire story and preview ran on those three. The liability moved C$20.9m in its first two-month stub period in FY2025 against a Q2 FY2026 reported net income of C$24k, so a remeasurement of even a few million flips the reported bottom line to a loss against a quarter the company has already called a record. If the market had priced the mechanic, the Aug 4 release of record German tonnage would not have been a clean +4.65% up day, and the sell-side average target would not sit at $4.67 against a $2.57 spot with the put equal to roughly 19% of the US$221m market cap and settleable in cash or shares at High Tide's discretion from 2027-09-02.
findings.independence: The put's economics (3.64065x TTM adjusted EBITDA, cash-or-shares at High Tide's discretion, 5-year term after 24 months) are independently described in the deal announcement — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/high-tide-closes-acquisition-of-a-majority-stake-in-remexian-pharma-gmbh-302543298.html (2025-09-02). The carrying value and Monte Carlo inputs come from the Q2 FY2026 interim statements, the same document cluster as finding 3.

findings.finding: The German MedCanG amendment that would ban mail-order dispensing and require in-person consultation before a first cannabis prescription was NOT voted before the 2026 summer recess and remains stuck in the Bundestag health committee over an unresolved coalition split on the scope of the mail-order ban, with a vote realistically no earlier than September 2026 and implementation drifting to late autumn/winter 2026.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (page states the bill was not called before the summer recess 2026 and remains in the Gesundheitsausschuss; vote expected 'from September 2026 at the earliest')
findings.why_not_priced: English-language cannabis coverage last framed this as 'Germany advances MedCanG amendments' and readers carried a spring-2026 enactment as the base case; the granular status — which committee, which coalition disagreement, which reading has not happened — exists only in German-language legal and trade sources. Remexian is a pharmacy wholesaler whose growth is fed by telemedicine-driven mail-order demand, so the delay is a direct extension of the runway that is under-reported in exactly the sources a cannabis analyst reads. If it were priced, the stock would not have traded to $2.15 on 2026-08-03, within 6% of its 52-week low, in the same week it pre-announced a record German quarter.
findings.independence: The scope of the proposed ban and the spring-2026 expectation it is now slipping from are documented separately at https://www.gleisslutz.com/en/know-how/update-cannabis-legalisation-german-federal-government-prohibit-telemedical-prescriptions-medical-cannabis and the government bill itself is BT-Drs. 21/3061, https://dserver.bundestag.de/btd/21/030/2103061.pdf (2025-12-03).

findings.finding: Free cash flow is the one metric the pre-announcement left out and it was already deteriorating before the German step-up: Q2 FY2026 FCF fell to C$1.5m from C$4.9m a year earlier on working-capital investment, TTM FCF is C$13.4m, cash was C$36.5m against C$68.2m of debt, and the company has publicly committed to staying FCF-positive for fiscal 2026 while Q3 revenue steps up C$16-21m sequentially on receivables-heavy German distribution plus a 20+ store build.
findings.why_not_priced: The Aug 4 release named revenue, gross profit and adjusted EBITDA and was silent on cash; the preview coverage and the Zacks/consensus frame are built on those three. If cash conversion were the market's focus, the C$40m BMO facility closed on 2026-08-05 — of which C$25m refinances a C$6m connectFirst balance and C$15m refinances existing second-lien debentures, so it adds almost no net new headroom against a C$57.9m put falling due from 2027 — would have been read as a liquidity event rather than as the cost-of-capital win the headline sold.
findings.independence: The facility's use of proceeds is stated independently at https://hightideinc.com/high-tide-secures-credit-approval-for-c40mm-of-senior-secured-credit-facilities/ . The Q2 FCF figure shares the 2026-06-15 filing cluster with finding 1 but comes from the earnings release exhibit, not the interim statements.

searched_and_found_nothing: Dilution / share count: 87,870,176 shares outstanding at 2026-06-15 (Q2 MD&A) against 87.87m today (stockanalysis.com, 2026-09-14) — flat. The C$100m base shelf dated 2025-08-11 has had no ATM distribution agreement or prospectus supplement entered into. The sweep's 'share count is a direct unpriced datum' angle came up empty and is, if anything, a small positive.

SEC EDGAR 6-K stream: nothing filed since 2026-08-31 (three new Canna Cabana stores). No quiet 8-K/6-K equivalent ahead of the print. The 2026-08-12 6-K is only AGM voting results, including an amended and restated shareholder rights plan passed at 91.07% — routine renewal, no evidence of an approach.
Statistics Canada / provincial monthly cannabis retail sales for August 2026 — not published in time to say anything about the post-guidance window.
BfArM German import data for Q2/Q3 2026 — the Q1 2026 series was revised upward from 50.5t to 67.6t, so the public series is too unstable to read a Remexian read-through off.

US hemp redefinition (H.R.5371 s.781, effective 2026-11-12 / 2026-12-11 for most categories): High Tide's NuLeaf, FAB CBD and Blessed CBD full-spectrum lines are exposed, but the Q2 MD&A folds e-commerce and CBD into the bricks-and-mortar segment with no separate revenue line, so I could not size the exposure and will not guess it.
Customer-side signal: no usable Reddit/app-store/support-forum volume on Canna Cabana or Cabana ELITE; no evidence of an ELITE price change off the $5/month standard rate.

Rebuilding an earnings reaction base rate: stockanalysis.com only serves the trailing 50 sessions and paging was blocked, so the June-15 (Q2) and March-17 (Q1) print reactions could not be recovered. The historical anchor stays unavailable, as the brief instructed.
baseline_tension: The baseline has no usable option chain and therefore no skew to agree or disagree with, and its 0.9% expected move is built off eight 6-Ks that are store openings and an AGM rather than earnings — so the only real baseline constraint is the +9.36% 20-day run-up, and my findings cut with it: the stock has already been paid for a beat it announced six weeks ago (+19.3% from the 2026-08-03 close of $2.15), and what is left in the release is a put-option remeasurement and a cash-flow line the pre-announcement deliberately did not quantify.
